Instructions for Use
Device description: The Tern Transcatheter Valve is a transcatheter heart valve. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Tern Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. A person with the Tern Transcatheter Valve may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Tern Transcatheter Valve
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3 T
RF Transmit Coil Type There are no Transmit Coil restrictions
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions B1+RMS of 2 µT or less; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.5 W/kg
Scan Duration Scan for up to 15 minutes.
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 5 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
